User.title: User Profile
User.description: Base profile document indexed strictly by Firebase UID.

UserSettings.title: User Settings & BYOK
UserSettings.description: User configuration, voice preferences, and encrypted BYOK Gemini API key.

hasCustomApiKey.description: Whether user configured their own Gemini API key

maskedApiKey.description: Masked representation of API key (e.g., AIza••••••••1234)

encryptedApiKey.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted API key, managed on backend only

UserUsage.title: User Character Usage & Balance
UserUsage.description: Strictly UID-isolated internal quota balance for site API usage. Never shared globally.

usedCharacters.description: Total characters consumed via site API

Generation.title: TTS Audio Generation
Generation.description: Individual speech synthesis generation record owned exclusively by UID.

audioUrl.description: Data URL or storage URL for synthesized audio

idempotencyKey.description: Client idempotency key preventing duplicate runs

usedByok.description: Whether user's BYOK key was used

/users/{uid}.description: User profile document. Only readable and writable by the authenticated user matching UID.

/users/{uid}/settings/general.description: User settings and BYOK metadata. Only readable and writable by the authenticated user matching UID.

/users/{uid}/usage/balance.description: User character balance. Readable by UID, modified transactionally by backend server.

/users/{uid}/generations/{generationId}.description: User generation records. Only accessible and listable by UID.
